description: This file is a shell script designed to perform tests related to the diff indentation heuristic in a version control context (likely Git). It contains test definitions for comparing diff outputs, blame outputs, and various diff-related commands with different heuristics and configuration options.

methods.name: compare_diff
methods.description: Compares two diff output files after removing 'index' lines to check for differences.

methods.name: compare_blame
methods.description: Compares blame output files after filtering out initial lines and certain prefixes to verify similarity.
